description: This source file provides functions for managing file locking, symlink resolution, and related operations within the Git version control system. It specifically handles lockfile creation, retry mechanisms with backoff, and symlink resolution to ensure safe locking practices.

classes.name: struct lock_file
classes.description: Represents a lockfile, including its temporary filename and file descriptor.

methods.name: void trim_last_path_component(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Removes the last component of a path, effectively moving up one directory level.

methods.name: void resolve_symlink(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Follows symbolic links in a path, updating the path to point to the actual file or directory.

methods.name: int lock_file(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile, resolving symlinks before doing so.

methods.name: int lock_file_timeout(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)
methods.description: Attempts to lock a file with retries and exponential backoff within a specified timeout.

methods.name: void unable_to_lock_message(const char * path,int err,struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Generates an error message when a lock cannot be acquired.

methods.name: NORETURN void unable_to_lock_die(const char * path,int err)
methods.description: Terminates execution with an error message if locking fails.

methods.name: int hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode(struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)
methods.description: Main function to acquire a lockfile, with support for timeout and error handling flags.

methods.name: char * get_locked_file_path(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical path of the locked file (excluding the .lock suffix).

methods.name: int commit_lock_file(struct lock_file * lk)
methods.description: Commits the lock file to its final location, completing the lock acquisition.

ctags.name: hold_lock_file_for_update_timeout_mode
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)

ctags.name: lock_file
ctags.pattern: /^static int lock_file(struct lock_file *lk, const char *path, int flags,$/
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,int mode)

ctags.name: lock_file_timeout
ctags.signature: (struct lock_file * lk,const char * path,int flags,long timeout_ms,int mode)

ctags.name: unable_to_lock_message
ctags.pattern: /^void unable_to_lock_message(const char *path, int err, struct strbuf *buf)$/
